viewing_check: Look at the map out of the frame if possible, or at least the margins: a genuine c.1851 steel engraving has a plate mark, slight toning and an 'Engraved by J. Rapkin' / 'John Tallis & Co' imprint; facsimiles usually have a flat printed dot or halftone pattern under a loupe (colour in dots), bright modern paper, and no plate mark. Check for a rear label or dealer ticket, and the foxing and verso text (originals often have text or a blank back). Note the sheet size (about 27 x 36 cm original).
